Need to clarify alignment for `heze-devnet-2`:

- Blob schedule (EL)
- Slot duration (CL)

I'd like to discuss https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627 on the CL breakout one more time, I recently added more motivation behind the requested API endpoint to the PR [here](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627#issuecomment-6012901023).

I've confirmed interest in this endpoint from multi-node validator clients (Vero, Vouch) and DVT (Obol). This endpoint makes a lot of sense for these setups.

If it makes people more comfortable, I'd be happy to tag this endpoint as `Experimental` and have all consumers treat it that way (off by default, behind a dangerous/experimental flag, ...).
